类 BaseServlet

javax.servlet.GenericServlet
javax.servlet.http.HttpServlet
com.bupt.ta.servlet.BaseServlet
所有已实现的接口:

直接已知子类:
AdminApplicationManagementServlet, AdminAuditLogsServlet, AdminDashboardServlet, AdminWorkloadServlet, ApplicationManagementServlet, ApplicationServlet, ChangePasswordServlet, DashboardServlet, LoginServlet, LogoutServlet, ManageJobServlet, MOProgressServlet, PostJobServlet, ProfileServlet, QuickApplyServlet, RegisterServlet, ResumeDownloadServlet, ResumePreviewServlet, UserManagementServlet
public abstract class BaseServlet extends javax.servlet.http.HttpServlet
Abstract base Servlet providing common methods for all Servlets in the TA recruitment system.

Encapsulates common functionality such as retrieving the currently logged-in user, checking login status, permission verification, and request forwarding. All concrete business Servlets should extend this class.

      protected User getCurrentUser(javax.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest req)
      Retrieves the logged-in user object from the current session.

      protected boolean isLoggedIn(javax.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest req)

      protected boolean requireLogin(javax.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest req, javax.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse resp) throws IOException

    • requirePermission

      protected boolean requirePermission(javax.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest req, javax.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse resp, User.Role requiredRole) throws IOException
      Requires the current user to have the specified role permission, otherwise returns a 403 error.
      参数:
      req - HTTP request
      resp - HTTP response
